js: (async () => { window.__jobs = []; window.api.on.job((j) => { window.__jobs.push({kind:j.kind,status:j.status,progress:j.progress,message:j.message,error:j.error}); console.log('JOB ' + j.kind + ' ' + j.status + ' p=' + Math.round(j.progress*100) + '% msg=' + (j.message||'') + ' err=' + (j.error||'')); }); console.log('LISTENER OK'); })()

(async () => { const p = (await window.api.projects.list()).find((x) => x.id === '2c8361fc-04eb-4fbf-afff-391915e37042'); if (!p) { console.log('DEMO GAGAL: proyek tidak ditemukan'); return; } try { const job = await window.api.exporter.start(p.id, {fileName:'demo-720p', resolution:720, fps:30, burnCaptions:true, writeSrt:true, normalizeAudio:true, duckMusic:true, folder:'/home/hatch/workspace/fase0-0.2a/bang-story-03-tier1-naskah-per-bagian/bukti-naskah-per-bagian/regress/demo-reg'}); console.log('DEMO STARTED job=' + job.id + ' status=' + job.status); } catch (e) { console.log('DEMO CALL FAILED: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e)); } })()

(() => { const j = window.__jobs.filter((x) => x.kind==='export'); const last = j[j.length-1]; console.log('DEMO LAST: ' + JSON.stringify(last)); console.log('DEMO COUNT: ' + j.length + ' done=' + j.filter((x)=>x.status==='done').length + ' failed=' + j.filter((x)=>x.status==='failed').length); })()
